summary: All three blocking findings are valid spec contradictions or missing safety policy and should be repaired in one spec-repair pass. Non-blocking improvements remain advisory memory.

items.title: Pass nextAction conflicts with existing finalize step
items.rationale: The spec currently gives two different pass routing values. The executable next step after final-regression pass is finalize-commit, so the artifact contract must use the same value.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R3 says nextAction=finalize, while R7 says route to finalize-commit. flow status and definition show finalize-commit is the first finalize leaf after final-regression.

items.title: Final-regression repair can stale prior evidence
items.rationale: A repair after retro can modify files after test-execute, test-result-review, gate-impl, and retro evidence. The spec must require fresh spec-local evidence and artifact consumption before finalize without re-entering review/gate-impl.
items.evidence: spec.json R5 allows one retryable failure but does not state what happens to earlier test-execute/test-result-review/retro evidence when files change after final-regression.

items.title: invalid_project_test retry route is ambiguous
items.rationale: invalid_project_test should be a bounded test-repair path, not a non-retryable stop category, because issue #330 explicitly lists invalid_project_test as test-repair -> final-regression.
items.evidence: Issue #330 says invalid_project_test: test-repair -> final-regression. spec.json R4 currently lists invalid_project_test among retryable=false stop categories.
